native_mechanisms: A single rolling sphere is the sole carried memory across the whole ordered pile of marks
Each mark is pressed into the sphere then tumbled a fixed count of turns (strike/sob/crack = add-rotate-xor of the state against a displaced copy of itself) before the next mark is taken
Only the final hairline crack in the last stalk is kept as the token; all intermediate cracks, dust and discarded footprints are swept away
One wrong mark reshapes the whole sphere, not a sliver — every downstream stalk sobs differently (full-state diffusion / avalanche)
core_technique: SipHash-2-4 with a zero key: one 256-bit four-word state, each 8-byte little-endian word XOR-absorbed and mixed by a fixed 2 SipRound ARX (add/rotate/xor, no multiply) permutations, length byte in the tail word, 4 finalization rounds, folded to one 64-bit word — plus a non-standard 32-byte-per-2-rounds wide fast path.
